# Packaged dependency licenses

These texts accompany the official Windows x64 build:

| File | Component | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `CPYTHON-3.13.15-PSF-LICENSE.txt` | CPython 3.13.15 | https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.13.15 |
| `CPYTHON-3.14.7-PSF-LICENSE.txt` | CPython 3.14.7 local-build runtime | https://github.com/python/cpython/tree/v3.14.7 |
| `TCL-8.6-LICENSE.txt` | Tcl 8.6 | https://github.com/tcltk/tcl/tree/core-8-6-branch |
| `TK-8.6-LICENSE.txt` | Tk 8.6 | https://github.com/tcltk/tk/tree/core-8-6-branch |
| `TCL-9.0-LICENSE.txt` | Tcl 9.0 local-build runtime | https://github.com/tcltk/tcl/tree/core-9-0-branch |
| `TK-9.0-LICENSE.txt` | Tk 9.0 local-build runtime | https://github.com/tcltk/tk/tree/core-9-0-branch |
| `BLEAK-1.1.1-MIT.txt` | Bleak 1.1.1 | https://github.com/hbldh/bleak/tree/v1.1.1 |
| `PYWINRT-MIT.txt` | PyWinRT 3.2.1 modules | https://github.com/pywinrt/pywinrt |
| `TYPING_EXTENSIONS-PSF.txt` | typing_extensions | https://github.com/python/typing_extensions |
| `VGAMEPAD-0.1.0-MIT.txt` | vgamepad 0.1.0 | https://github.com/yannbouteiller/vgamepad/tree/v0.1.0 |
| `VIGEMCLIENT-MIT.txt` | ViGEmClient bundled by vgamepad | https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmClient |
| `PYINSTALLER-6.22.2-COPYING.txt` | PyInstaller bootloader and exception | https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/tree/v6.22.2 |

VIIPER's GPLv3 text remains in `runtime/VIIPER_LICENSE.txt`; its exact
corresponding source is a separate asset in every official Release.
